summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for approval-stamp template behavior. Core renderDocumentTemplate and DocumentPrint wiring contracts passed; one frontend readiness issue and one preview-edge CORS mismatch observed.

minor.issue: Credentialed CORS explicit-origin check returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' in preview endpoint during test run (expected exact origin).

integration_issues.issue: When customer name is empty, renderer intentionally skips CUSTOMER_NAME replacement, leaving unresolved variable and blocking resolved-template preview with 'القالب غير مكتمل: CUSTOMER_NAME'.

action_items: If requirement is strict 'no raw placeholders in final HTML at all times', replace CUSTOMER_NAME with safe fallback (e.g., —) instead of skipping replacement when empty.
Recheck credentialed CORS response on deployment edge/proxy: explicit origin is expected with allow_credentials=true.
critical_code_review_comments: Approval stamp matrix contract passed in renderer: no stamp without approvals, customer/workshop independent stamps, dual approvals produce two stamps, no raw CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_STAMP/WORKSHOP_APPROVAL_STAMP tokens after render.
DocumentPrint correctly passes approvals into templatePayload and uses renderedTemplate for print flow (iframe srcdoc) and resolved-template preview pipeline.
Auth playbook checks: bcrypt $2b$ hash, HttpOnly+SameSite=None cookie flags, brute-force lockout after repeated failures, and manager seed path wiring are working.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12 selected checks passed across two pytest runs)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (targeted DocumentPrint checks passed; initial unresolved CUSTOMER_NAME guard blocks ready preview until user input)

context_for_next_testing_agent: For strict template-completeness expectation, start from /print and inspect template guard before filling customer name. Approval stamp scenarios were validated at renderer contract level via Node-based pytest harness (UI has no direct manual approvals toggles in this page).
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (frontend): in renderDocumentTemplate, replacement loop skips WORKSHOP_NAME/CUSTOMER_NAME when value is empty, so {CUSTOMER_NAME} survives unresolved scan and DocumentPrint guard blocks resolved template. Repro: login -> /print -> wait; alert shows missing CUSTOMER_NAME until user fills name. Mitigation: replace with fallback value instead of skipping for strict no-placeholder rule. RCA-2 (CORS): OPTIONS test on preview endpoint returned '*' despite backend explicit-origin middleware; likely edge normalization behavior, needs deployment-level verification.
